values: Federal FY2025 date range (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive)
Permit effective date relative to the six-month plan-submission deadline
Adjacent Delta-BHC Study provisions in Part I.B establishing post-approval quarterly sampling in permit years 2–5

grounding.excerpt: The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water intake within six months after the effective date of the permit to both EPA and NMED for approval.
Once approved, the permittee must collect and analyze samples for delta-BHC at least once a quarter or more frequent during the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th year of the permit.

rationale: The packet establishes two distinct Delta-BHC obligations in Part I.B: (1) submit a detailed study plan within six months of the permit effective date, and (2) after agency approval, collect and analyze source-water-intake samples at least quarterly during permit years 2–5. To determine which obligation applies during Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30), one must know the permit effective date (to locate FY2025 within the permit term and relative to the six-month plan deadline) and whether the study plan was approved (because sampling is conditioned on approval). Neither the permit effective date nor plan-approval status appears in the packet. ACCEPT would require grounded evidence that Delta-BHC testing or sampling at the source water intake was required during FY2025; REJECT would require grounded evidence that the obligation during FY2025 was solely plan submission with no applicable sampling duty. The available excerpts do not establish either timeline-dependent conclusion, and absence of the effective date cannot be converted into negative closure. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
